correlations: Pearson correlations of original labelled training columns; descriptive only.
boundaries: Original train and test input counts at -1 or +1.
degree: Development five-fold CV tables; Ridge minimized over bases and penalties.
penalty: Original monomial CV tables; unconverged Lasso candidates masked.
diagnostics: Saved predictions for 200 holdout rows per problem; no final-fit predictions used.
responses: Saved full-training models on a 101 by 101 grid, other inputs fixed at zero.
